head.low_quality: Image quality too low for analysis
msg.no_plant: No recognizable plant or leaf detected. Please upload a clear image of a plant or leaf.
msg.leaf_not_visible: A plant may be present, but no leaf is clearly visible, so this image is unsuitable for reliable leaf analysis. Please upload a close, well-lit photo of a single leaf.
msg.quality.too_small: The image resolution is too low.
msg.quality.too_dark: The image is too dark or poorly lit.
msg.retake: Please take a clearer photograph: hold the camera steady, use natural daylight (avoid harsh direct sun and flash), fill the frame with one leaf and tap to focus.
msg.read_error: The file could not be read as an image. Please upload a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
msg.analysis_failed: Something went wrong while analysing the image. Please try again with another photo.
msg.model_missing: The disease model is not installed. Train it first (see README) and place it in models/plant_classifier.pt. Image validation still works, but no diagnosis can be given.
msg.healthy: No obvious signs of disease detected. The plant appears healthy based on the image.
msg.healthy_caveat: A single photo cannot rule out early-stage disease, pests, nutrient problems or issues on the other side of the leaf or on other plants. Keep monitoring.
msg.lean_healthy: The model leans towards 'healthy' but is not confident enough to say so. Treat this as inconclusive.
msg.healthy_cues_conflict: The model leans towards 'healthy', but possible visual cues were noticed ({cues}). These conflict, so no conclusion is given.
msg.unable: Unable to determine. The plant, the condition or the photo may be outside what this model was trained on, so no diagnosis is offered.
msg.inconclusive: The model cannot reliably distinguish between several possibilities, so no diagnosis is given. The closest candidates are listed below for reference only.
msg.preliminary: This is a preliminary, image-based prediction, not a guaranteed diagnosis. It may require confirmation by a plant pathologist or your local agricultural extension service.
msg.low_accuracy: Model limitation: this model's measured test accuracy is only {acc}, which is below the recommended level. Treat all results with extra caution.
actions.healthy:
Keep monitoring leaves weekly, including the undersides.
Maintain steady watering and good airflow.
Photograph the plant again if anything changes.
actions.disease:
Confirm the problem on several leaves/plants before acting.
Remove and bin (do not compost) severely affected leaves; wash tools afterwards.
Avoid pesticides or fungicides until the problem is confirmed by an expert or local extension office.
actions.inconclusive:
Retake the photo in natural daylight: one leaf, in focus, filling the frame; also photograph the underside.
Tell the app the plant species and growing conditions in the Plant care tab.
If symptoms spread, contact a local agricultural extension service or plant clinic.
care.needs.water: Needs a finger test (top 2-3 cm of soil) or a soil-moisture meter. A photo cannot measure soil moisture.
care.needs.sunlight: Needs a light meter or a log of hours of direct sun. A photo cannot measure light intensity.
care.needs.soil: Needs a drainage test (fill a 30 cm hole with water and time how long it takes to drain) and ideally a soil pH/nutrient test.
care.needs.temp_humidity: Needs a thermometer/hygrometer or local weather data. A photo cannot measure temperature or humidity.
care.needs.nutrients: Leaf colour alone cannot confirm a deficiency. A soil or leaf-tissue test is needed before adding fertiliser.
care.needs.pests: Inspect leaf undersides and stems (a hand lens helps). A single photo can miss insects and eggs.
care.moisture_reading: Your soil-moisture reading: {v}%. Meters differ by brand and soil type, so compare with the meter's own dry/moist scale and a finger test.
care.range_below: {label}: your value {value}{unit} is below the typical range for {species} ({lo}-{hi}{unit}).
care.range_within: {label}: your value {value}{unit} is within the typical range for {species} ({lo}-{hi}{unit}).
care.range_above: {label}: your value {value}{unit} is above the typical range for {species} ({lo}-{hi}{unit}).
care.q.species: What species is the plant? (Not identified or not in the supported list.)
care.q.climate: What is your climate or region (e.g. humid tropical, dry temperate)?
care.q.general:
Is it grown in the ground, a raised bed or a container?
When was it last watered, and how often do you water?
Has anything changed recently (weather, fertiliser, pesticide, repotting)?
Is only one plant affected, or several?

ui.confidence_help: The model's own estimate for the classes it knows. It is not a guarantee of being correct, especially for photos unlike its training data.
ui.supported_help: The disease model only knows these plants. Other plants are reported as 'unable to determine'.
